How does NutriMesh calculate macros from a single shared pot?

When you log a shared pot (e.g. 4 katoris of Dal Makhani or 600g cooked Rajma), NutriMesh calculates the total pot caloric and nutrient density. As each member logs their allocated portion (e.g. 1.5 katoris vs 1 katori), the apportionment algorithm calculates their exact personal intake and checks it against their ICMR-NIN RDA targets.
Do we need to weigh every raw ingredient separately?

No! You can use our frictionless AI logger: simply take a quick photo of the kadai, speak naturally into the app in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu or English, or pick standard standardized recipes from our 450+ verified regional Indian catalogue.
What is the 1-Katori Micro Swap recommendation?

Instead of forcing cooks to prepare a separate keto or high-protein dinner for one family member, our Linear Programming (LP) optimization engine recommends micro adjustments on the plate: for instance, adding 1 katori of sprouted moong, boiled chana, or curd to close the target gap effortlessly.
Does NutriMesh accommodate Vrat and Indian Fasting days?

Yes! NutriMesh features dedicated Vrat intelligence for Navratri, Ekadashi, and Shravan. It adjusts your nutritional targets and suggests compliant ingredients such as Sabudana, Kuttu, Singhara atta, Makhana, and Rock Salt (Sendha Namak).
